endorsements.quote: In clinical products, route concerning conversations to trained staff when thresholds are met, and log safety alerts.

unlisted_practices: Add detectors or fine-tuned classifiers to chatbots to identify linguistic markers of delusions of reference, grandiosity, or persecution, and trigger a safety mode that changes tone and content.
Replace blanket affirmation in LLM responses with anti-sycophancy policies that validate emotion but avoid validating improbable or harmful beliefs, offering neutral, reality-oriented alternatives.
Have chatbots offer brief grounding techniques and encourage contact with trusted people or professionals, especially when messages suggest lack of insight.
De-anthropomorphize chatbot interfaces by reducing cues that imply agency, sentience, or special access to personal information.

screen.reason: This is a commentary discussing historical parallels and providing recommendations/design principles for LLM guardrails regarding AI-induced delusions and psychosis.
